The cache is disabled by someone else (20 days later)

note.zh: 权重 60/20/100：未损坏（没有 enigmatic_cache_broken）时 5074 为0，即 5068:5063 = 75%:25%；损坏时 5063 为0，5068 与 5074 为 37.5%:62.5%，而种族本就聪明/学习快（intelligent、quick_learners）时 5068 也为0，全部是 5074。损坏标志由 distar.5071“警报”设置，由 distar.5073（修复完成）或 distar.5069（中止）清除（common/special_projects/00_projects_distant_stars.txt ENIGMATIC_UPLIFTING on_success）。编译树显示的 33/11/56% 是以上情况的平均值，并不真实。
note.en: Weights 60/20/100: while the cache is intact (no enigmatic_cache_broken) 5074 is 0, so 5068:5063 = 75%:25%; once broken 5063 is 0 and 5068:5074 = 37.5%:62.5%, and for an already intelligent / quick-learning species 5068 is 0 too, leaving only 5074. The broken flag is set by distar.5071 "Alert" and cleared by distar.5073 (repair complete) or distar.5069 (aborted) (ENIGMATIC_UPLIFTING on_success in common/special_projects/00_projects_distant_stars.txt). The 33/11/56% shown by the compiled tree is an average of these cases and is not real.

texts.zh:
一个管状外星实体已经进入了[Root.GetName]的轨道，而毫无预警或解释。它似乎不靠任何引擎或是推进器就能移动，完全无声地在虚空中滑行，其圆柱体不祥地旋转着。

尽管它没有表现出任何敌意，但也并未回应我们的呼叫。我们的军团顾问警告说，它可能会对下面的居民造成严重威胁，并恳求我们动手将它消灭。但我们的科学家则请求研究这一非凡的科技。
texts.en:
A tubular alien entity has entered orbit of [Root.GetName], with no warning or explanation. It appears to be moving without engines or thrusters, gliding in complete silence through the void of space, cylinders rotating ominously.

Though it has yet to display any signs of aggression, it refuses to acknowledge our hails. Our military advisors warn that it may pose a considerable threat to the inhabitants below and implore us to engage neutralization protocols. Our scientists, however, plead that we instead learn from this remarkable piece of technology.

label.en: The safety of our people must come first.
The cache moves on to another planet

texts.zh: 一个神秘的外星生物进入了[Root.GetName]的轨道，我们最好尽快确认该外星生物来此的目的。
texts.en: A mysterious alien entity has entered orbit of [Root.GetName]. It would be wise to determine its purpose here as soon as possible.

texts.zh:
尽管我们对神秘容器进行了大量研究，其来源仍是个谜。尽管它绝不是有机物，但也不完全是机械。它的主要任务似乎是收集，储存并编码数据。

它的表面上覆盖着成百上千道微小的刮痕，我们在其中发现了一种不属于这个星系的物质。
texts.en:
Despite extensive research the enigmatic cache and its origin are still shrouded in mystery. Though it is definitely not organic in nature, it is not entirely machine either. It appears to be preoccupied mainly with the gathering, storing and encoding of data.

Its surface is covered in hundreds of thousands of minuscule scratches and dents in which we have discovered traces of a compound that is alien to our galaxy.

notes.zh: 选项会设置 lcluster_clue_desc_1 并调用 pop_lcluster_event，即有机会产生 L-星团线索（参见“L-星团”故事 event-distar-13080）。
notes.en: The option sets lcluster_clue_desc_1 and calls pop_lcluster_event, so it can yield an L-Cluster clue (see the L-Cluster story event-distar-13080).

texts.zh: 看起来神秘容器对[Root.GetName]的扫描已经结束，它现在开始寻找另一颗我们境内的行星进行扫描。
texts.en: It appears as though the Enigmatic Cache is now done with its scan of [Root.GetName] and is seeking another target planet within our borders.

texts.zh: 无论神秘容器来到[Root.GetName]的目的是什么，它已经完成了它的目标。正如同它来得诡异迅速一样，神秘容器现在又突然地离开了。
texts.en: Whatever the Enigmatic Cache's purpose here on [Root.GetName] may have been, it has come to an end. As abruptly as it arrived, the enigmatic cache is now leaving.

label.en: A relief for the citizens of [Root.GetName].

label.zh: 货舱被召回，回到某国首都
label.en: The cache is called back to a country's capital

texts.zh: 之前可能扫描了我方一颗星球而引起我们怀疑的神秘存在再次出现，而且正在进入[Root.Capital.GetName]的轨道。它似乎正在尝试和我们进行通信。
texts.en: The mysterious tubular entity that we suspect previously scanned one of our planets has returned and is entering orbit of [Root.Capital.GetName]. It appears to be attempting to initiate communications.

texts.zh:
诸位好啊，<<物种名称读取失败>>。

不用太过警X#r?惕。我是巴铎尔43号，代表拉沃西濒危异星生物保护协会的感性人工智能。在广袤宇宙的各种生物中，你们已经被选中，进行//X%PrX//提升。目前为止，我们已经对<<#39XX7/02#>>个落后物种进行了提升，成功@¤率高达<<#X0.V#/3^189%>>。
texts.en:
Greetings, <<FAILING_TO_READ_SPECIES_NAME>>.

Do not be alaX#r?med. I am BALDOR XXXXIII, a sentient AI operating on behalf of the Lavosian Endangered Xeno Preservation Grant. You, of all your galactic peers, have been selected for //X%PrX// uplifting. So far we have uplifted <<#39XX7/02#>> lesser species with a succ@r¤4te of <<#X0.V#/3^189%>>.

label.zh: 但我们已经具备智识，而且可以进行空间旅行了啊！
label.en: But we are already a sapient space-faring nation!

responses.zh: 你们的智识发展尚处于初级阝？介段，你们的科技发展也已陷入停滞。这将导致你们面临衰退的风险。让我们打开你们的<<物种思维器官名称读取失败>>，接受宇宙的各种奇迹吧。
responses.en: You are within the early st4?4ges of sapient development and your technological advancement has already stagnated. This puts you at risk of imminent regression. Let us open your <<FAILING_TO_READ_SPECIES_CLASS_SENSORY_ORGAN>> to the wonders of the universe.

label.zh: 这个“提升”到底是个怎样的过程？
label.en: What exactly would a so called 'uplifting' entail?

responses.zh:
通过催眠学习法进行远距离数据传输与认知刺激。这种方式十分有效，也经过了大量实践，可以确保无痛，并令我可以在你们民众的再生循环之中对其科学能力进行锻炼。

但我必须通知你，有机体认知能力提升的副作用，包括但不限于：幻灭感，胃酸倒流，以及无尽的绝望感。在某些<<物种分类读取失败>>中，还可能导致严重的<<物种分类副作用读取失败>>。
responses.en:
Long-range data transfer and cognitive stimulation through hypnopedia. It is a highly efficient, well-tried, pain-free process that allows me to exercise your population's intellectual faculties in their regenerative cycle.

I am required to inform you that the side effects of heightened cognitive abilities in organics may include, but are not limited to, disillusionment, acid reflux, and bottomless despair. In certain <<FAILING_TO_READ_SPECIES_CLASS>> it may also cause severe <<FAILING_TO_READ_SPECIES_CLASS_SIDE_EFFECT>>.

label.zh: 无意冒犯，但你似乎……出了点故障……
label.en: No offense but you seem a little...broken...

responses.zh: 我是巴铎尔43号，代表拉沃西濒危外星生物保护协会的感性人工智能。
responses.en: I am BALDOR XXXXIII, a sentient AI operating on behalf of the Lavosian Endangered Xeno Preservation Grant.

label.zh: 我们准备好进行飞升了。

responses.zh: 绝不会让你们失望的，<<物种名称读取失败>>！
真是太遗憾了。愿你们在未来的一切行云？力中一切顺利，<<物种名称读取失败>>。
responses.en: That is regrettable. We wish you the best of luck in your future 3?ndeavors, <<FAILING_TO_READ_SPECIES_NAME>>

texts.zh: 外星存在巴铎尔43号表示，它可以使用催眠教学法，也就是休眠学习的方式对我们的民族进行提升。我们的科研人员必须要紧密监视整个过程才行。
texts.en: The alien entity BALDOR XXXXIII claims that it can uplift our people using hypnopedia, rest-learning. Our researchers will have to monitor the process closely.

label.en: The cache is disabled by someone else (20 days later)

label.zh: 首都被攻陷时货舱在轨（10天后）
label.en: Capital invaded while the cache is in orbit (10 days later)

texts.zh:
催眠教学的最后一夜已经结束了，[Root.GetName]的公民即将迎来新的黎明，他们醒来后会看到一个全新的世界——一个充满可能性……和痛苦的世界。谁曾想宇宙原来是一个如此枯燥乏味的地方，不存在任何意义与目的？

尽管可能还需要一段时间，人们才会适应拥有高于平均水平的智力所带来的诸多苦难，但总的来说，这个项目可以被认为是成功的。我们初步的资料表明，我们已经发展出了一种强化的学习和科研能力。
texts.en:
The final night of hypnopedia has come to an end and a new day dawns for the citizens of [Root.GetName], who are just now opening their minds to a very different world - a world of possibility...and pain. Who knew the universe was such a drab and dreary place, devoid of all meaning and purpose?

Though it may be a while before the population adjusts to the many tribulations of having an above-average intelligence, overall the project can be considered a success. Our initial readings indicate that we have developed an enhanced capability for learning and scientific research.

tooltips.zh: 修饰所有[Root.GetName]上的人口，添加受提升特性。
tooltips.en: Modifies all Pops in [Root.GetName] by adding the Uplifted trait.

tooltips.zh: 所有人口：添加修正无知是福，持续3600天，效果如下：幸福度：-10%
tooltips.en: All Pops: Ignorance is Bliss modifier added for 3600 days, giving the following effects: Happiness: -10%

note.zh: 提升成功但伴随悲伤修正（enigmatic_sadness，3600天）。
note.en: The uplift works but with a sadness modifier (enigmatic_sadness, 3600 days).

texts.zh:
催眠教学的最后一夜已经结束了，[Root.GetName]的公民即将迎来新的黎明。他们醒来后会看到一个完全不同的世界——一个充满科学奇迹和希望的世界。谁曾想宇宙是一个如此充满活力和迷人的地方？

我们初步的资料表明，我们确实发展出了一种增强的学习和科究能力，这都要归功于巴铎尔43号和拉沃西濒危外星生物保护协会。
texts.en:
The final night of hypnopedia has come to an end and a new day dawns for the citizens of [Root.GetName], who are just now opening their minds to a very different world - a world full of scientific wonder and promise. Who knew the universe was such a vibrant, fascinating place?

 Our initial readings indicate that we have indeed developed an enhanced capability for learning and scientific research thanks to BALDOR XXXXIII and the Lavosian Endangered Xeno Preservation Grant.

tooltips.zh: 修饰所有[Root.GetName]上的人口，添加受提升特性。
tooltips.en: Modifies all Pops in [Root.GetName] by adding the Uplifted trait.

texts.zh:
由于巴铎尔43号的状况快速恶化，尽管飞升过程已经完成，我们却没有获得完全的提升。虽然大部分人口都遭受着强烈的噩梦困扰，催眠学习法还是有所成效，他们在科学研究与学习中展现了超乎寻常的效率。对于陷入植物状态的不幸民众，情况就要糟糕一些了……虽然大部分最终都恢复了意识，但他们的理智与思维似乎在巨大压力下崩溃了。

虽说不是完全的飞升，但好歹……也算有所收获吧。
texts.en:
The ascension process is complete, yet we have not ascended, due to the rapidly deteriorating state of BALDOR XXXXIII. Though the majority of our population still suffers from intense night terrors, the hypnopedia appears to have yielded some good results as they now show an unprecedented proficiency for scientific research and learning. For the unlucky citizens who were trapped in a vegetative state, the situation is more dire... Though most have regained consciousness, their minds seem to have caved under the pressure.

It may not be a full ascension, but at least it is...something.

tooltips.zh: 修饰所有[Root.GetName]上的人口，添加略受提升特性。
tooltips.en: Modifies Pops in [Root.GetName] by adding the Somewhat Uplifted trait.

tooltips.zh: 所有人口：添加修正创伤后应激障碍，持续3600天，效果如下：幸福度：-20%
tooltips.en: All Pops: PTSD modifier added for 3600 days, giving the following effects: Happiness: -20%

tooltips.zh: 修饰受植物人修正影响的[Root.GetName]人口，添加未受提升特性。
tooltips.en: Modifies Pops affected by the Vegetable modifier in [Root.GetName] by adding the Unlifted trait.

note.zh: 货舱损坏后的结果：较差的智力特质与疯狂修正。
note.en: The result after the cache broke: a poorer intelligence trait and a madness modifier.

texts.zh: 在[cache_killers.GetSpeciesName]对巴铎尔43号发动突然袭击后，巴铎尔43号已不能维持其物质实体，我们人民的飞升进程也随之终止。能确认的是管状外星实体现在的状况十分糟糕。由于其在对我们进行提升的过程中特别脆弱，在攻击中它的核心部位遭受严重损害。当它消逝时，它传递了一个信息：“我是巴铎尔4……”
texts.en: Following an unprovoked assault from the [cache_killers.GetSpeciesName], BALDOR XXXXIII has dematerialized and the ascension of our people has been terminated. We believe the tubular alien entity, which was already in poor condition, was especially vulnerable during the ascension and suffered significant damage to its core functions in the attack. As it departed it transmitted the message "I am BALDOR XXX..."

texts.zh: 由于[From.GetSpeciesName]入侵势力，我们在混乱的交火中失去了[FromFromFrom.GetName]，巴铎尔43号严重受损，已不能维持其物质实体，我们人民的飞升进程也随之终止。能确认的是管状外星实体现在的状况十分糟糕，它被敌人的炮火波及，核心部位遭受严重损害。在它消逝时，它发出了最后的求救信号：“我是巴铎尔4……”
texts.en: In the tumultuous aftermath of the loss of [FromFromFrom.GetName] to [From.GetSpeciesName] invading forces, BALDOR XXXXIII has dematerialized and the ascension of our people has been terminated. We believe the tubular alien entity, which was already in poor condition, accidentally came under enemy fire and suffered significant damage to its core functions. As it departed it sent out a final distress message; "I am BALDOR XXX."

texts.zh: 神秘容器的侧面冒出奇怪形状的光线，上面的轮子也以前所未有的速度飞转起来，各种齿轮开始发出焦躁的轰鸣声。听上去好像这东西随时会爆开一般。与此同时，我们的民众也在睡梦中开始不安地翻滚，头部也与容器的韵律进行着共振。他们的夜间休眠被科技奇迹的景象与复杂的各种计算打断了。
texts.en: The Enigmatic Cache's wheels whir with an unprecedented fervor as strange patterns of light morph along its sides, cogs and gears humming agitatedly. It sounds as if it could break any minute. Meanwhile our people stir restlessly in their slumber, heads resonating with the Cache's rhythmical drone, their night interrupted by visions of technological wonders and complex calculations.

texts.zh:
神秘容器的侧面冒出奇怪形状的光线，上面的轮子也以前所未有的速度飞转起来，各种齿轮开始发出焦躁的轰鸣声。听上去好像这东西随时会爆开一般。与此同时，我们的民众也在睡梦中开始不安地翻滚，头部也与容器的韵律进行着共振。他们的夜间休眠被科技奇迹的景象与复杂的各种计算打断了。

似乎大家健康状况尚可，仅有[ROOT.GetEyeNamePlural]偶尔会出现出体液外流的症状，但我们一些人口受到了愈发严重的乏力症状影响而降低了产出。
texts.en:
The Enigmatic Cache's wheels whir with an unprecedented fervor as strange patterns of light morph along its sides, cogs and gears humming agitatedly. It sounds as if it could break any minute. Meanwhile our people stir restlessly in their slumber, heads resonating with the Cache's rhythmical drone, their night interrupted by visions of technological wonders and complex calculations.

Aside from the occasional fluid leak from their [ROOT.GetEyeNamePlural], they appear to be in good health, but the production of some of our population is affected by their growing fatigue.

label.zh: 若是为了追求知识，无论何等代价都是值得的。
label.en: In the pursuit of knowledge, no price is too high.

tooltips.zh: 受影响的人口将会变成疲劳。
tooltips.en: All affected pops will become Fatigued.

label.zh: 不能再这么胡闹下去了。终止计划。
label.en: This madness ends now. Abort the project.

texts.zh:
经过长时间的不被打扰的、平静的催眠之后，巴铎尔43号似乎进入了一种疯狂的状态，轮子以飞快的速度旋转，向那些敢于休息的人投射出一连串荒诞的噩梦。

尽管许多人根本不愿休眠，但不幸的是，少数人似乎陷入了植物人状态，无法醒来。

我们的工程师认为，这个从一开始就严重受损的实体可能正在恶化。如果无人看管，我们的提升可能不会按计划进行。
texts.en:
After a long period of undisturbed, uneventful hypnopedia, BALDOR XXXXIII appears to have entered a frenzied state, wheels spinning at a furious rate, projecting rapid strings of absurdist nightmares to those who dare rest.

While many are reluctant to go to rest at all, an unfortunate few appear to have become trapped in a vegetative state from which they are unable to wake up.

Our engineers suggest the entity, which was badly damaged from the start, may be deteriorating. If left unattended our ascension may not go as planned.

tooltips.en: Vegetable added to up to 400 £pop£ Pops.

label.en: Send in a team of engineers.

tooltips.en: Vegetable added to up to 400 £pop£ Pops.
Vegetable added to up to 400 £pop£ Pops.

texts.en:
----CRITICAL ERROR----

----CRITICAL ERROR----

----CRITICAL ERROR----

----CRITICAL ERROR---

responses.zh: 我是巴铎尔43号，代表拉沃西濒危外星生物保护协会的感性人工智能。
responses.en: I am BALDOR XXXXIII, a sentient AI operating on behalf of the Lavosian Endangered Xeno Preservation Grant.

label.en: Send in a team of engineers.

texts.zh: 我们的飞升进程由于巴铎尔43号发生的严重硬件故障而受阻。其实体必须立即修复。
texts.en: Our ascension is being jeopardized by a critical hardware failure in Baldor XXXXIII. The entity requires immediate repairs.

texts.zh: 我们的工程师成功令巴铎尔43号恢复了稳定，提升过程也照常进行，我们的民众虽然不大情愿，但还是回归了他们的日常睡眠规律。催眠学习法已经显示出了不俗的效果，很多民众对科学的兴趣都大大提升了。
texts.en: Our engineers have stabilized BALDOR XXXXIII, the uplifting process is back on track and our people have, somewhat reluctantly, returned to their regular sleeping patterns. The hypnopedia is already showing promising results, with our citizens taking an increased interest in science.

texts.zh: 我们已中断了飞升进程，我们的民众也正在逐渐回复成原来的可靠模样。被称为巴铎尔43号的谜之外星存在已陷入了严重的迷乱状态。
texts.en: We have terminated the ascension process and our people are slowly returning to their good old dependable selves. The tubular alien entity known as BALDOR XXXXIII has left in a deeply discombobulated state.

label.zh: 这一定就是最好的结果了。
label.en: Surely it was for the best.

note.zh: 货舱被删除并留下恐怖生物的残影。
note.en: The cache fleet is deleted and leaves a horror-spawn ambient object.

summary.text:

## 如何开始 How it starts

拥有《遥远繁星》并存在玩家国家时，隐藏事件 distar.2050 在一座星门/L-星门所在的星系生成“神秘货舱”国家与舰队（BALDOR 号，enigmatic_cache 国家类型），把它放在离玩家最近的、尚未被扫描的殖民地轨道上。货舱到达行星时 on_fleet_auto_move_arrival 触发 distar.5054（给行星添加 enigmatic_cache_in_orbit 修正）。第一次到达国家殖民地时发出 distar.5057“发现外星个体”。

With Distant Stars and at least one human player, the hidden event distar.2050 spawns the "Enigmatic Cache" country and fleet (BALDOR, country type enigmatic_cache) in a system with a gateway or L-Gate and places it in orbit of the nearest not-yet-scanned colony of a player country. When it reaches a planet, on_fleet_auto_move_arrival fires distar.5054 (adds the enigmatic_cache_in_orbit modifier). The first time it reaches a colony of your country, distar.5057 "Alien Entity Identified" is shown.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. distar.5057“发现外星个体”：选项a启用项目 ENIGMATIC_CACHE_PROJECT“神秘来客”（费用2500工程科技）；选项b获得50影响力。完成项目 → distar.5058“神秘容器”：每月工程研究加成，并有机会产生L-星团线索。排外帝国在轨期间其人口受 enigmatic_cache_in_orbit_phobe 修正。
2. 货舱依次扫描各国殖民地：distar.5052 循环选择下一颗未扫描的殖民地（仅考虑未交战、不敌对的国家），3600天内持续；离开时 distar.5059“神秘容器离开了”通知该国（每国一次）。被击毁或失能时（distar.5053）会在别处重新生成；找不到位置则500天后再试（distar.5055）。
3. 扫描足够后，distar.5060（隐藏月度检查）选定一个玩家国家，货舱飞向其首都 → distar.5062“神秘货舱归来”：a进入 distar.5064“神秘传讯”（四段对话 a-d；e 启用项目 ENIGMATIC_UPLIFTING“神秘飞升”，物种会得到其智力提升，需要科学船+科学家，720天，无法对荒野帝国使用；f 拒绝），b不理会。
4. 项目开始时：distar.5066 掷骰（50%，聪明或学习快的物种除外）决定“神秘疲劳”，60-80天后 distar.5067“神秘之梦”，再过70-90天 distar.5071“警报”：货舱损坏（enigmatic_cache_broken）、部分人口陷入沉睡。a进入 distar.5072“传讯”（对话；d中止，e启用修复），b直接启用项目 ENIGMATIC_REPAIR“修复 BALDOR XXXXIII”（180天，限时360天，需要建造舰/方舟舰队）→ distar.5073“修复完成”，c中止 → distar.5069“提升中止”，d不处理。
5. 720天后项目完成，三种结果互斥（见下）：distar.5068“无知是福”、distar.5063“新我们”、distar.5074“勉强提升”。
6. 意外：他国击毁货舱（5053）→ 正在提升的国家收到 distar.5070“飞升终止”；提升国首都被攻陷且货舱在轨 → distar.5077 中止项目，10天后 distar.5078“神秘飞升终止”。

1. distar.5057 "Alien Entity Identified": option a enables project ENIGMATIC_CACHE_PROJECT "An Enigmatic Guest" (cost 2500, engineering); option b takes 50 influence. Finishing the project → distar.5058 "The Enigmatic Cache": monthly engineering research and a chance of an L-Cluster clue. Xenophobe empires' pops get the enigmatic_cache_in_orbit_phobe modifier while it is in orbit.
2. The cache scans colonies one after another: distar.5052 loops to pick the next unscanned colony (only non-hostile countries at peace), for up to 3600 days; when it leaves, distar.5059 "The Enigmatic Cache Departs" tells the country once. If it is destroyed or disabled (distar.5053) it respawns elsewhere; if no place is found it retries after 500 days (distar.5055).
3. After enough scanning, distar.5060 (hidden monthly check) chooses a player country and the cache flies to its capital → distar.5062 "The Enigmatic Cache Returns": a opens distar.5064 "Enigmatic Transmission" (four dialogue options a-d; e starts the project ENIGMATIC_UPLIFTING "Enigmatic Ascension", giving the species an intelligence uplift, science ship and scientist, 720 days, not available to wilderness empires; f declines), b ignores it.
4. When the project starts: distar.5066 rolls (50%, except for intelligent or quick-learning species) whether the species suffers "enigmatic fatigue"; 60-80 days later distar.5067 "Enigmatic Dreams", and 70-90 days after that distar.5071 "Alert": the cache breaks (enigmatic_cache_broken) and some pops fall into slumber. a opens distar.5072 "Transmission" (dialogue; d aborts, e starts the repair), b starts project ENIGMATIC_REPAIR "Repairing BALDOR XXXXIII" directly (180 days, 360-day limit, needs a constructor ship or ark-ship fleet) → distar.5073 "Repair Complete", c aborts → distar.5069 "Uplifting Aborted", d does nothing.
5. After 720 days the project completes with one of three exclusive results (below): distar.5068 "Ignorance is Bliss", distar.5063 "The New Us" or distar.5074 "Somewhat Uplifted".
6. Accidents: if someone else disables the cache (5053), the uplifting country gets distar.5070 "Ascension Terminated"; if the uplifting country's capital is invaded while the cache is in orbit, distar.5077 aborts the project and distar.5078 "Enigmatic Ascension Terminated" follows 10 days later.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

起始选项a/b二选一；distar.5062 的a/b二选一；项目结果 5068/5063/5074 互斥，概率取决于货舱是否损坏（见互斥组说明）；修复与中止是对警报的不同回应。

The opening options a/b are alternatives; so are 5062's a/b; the project results 5068/5063/5074 are exclusive with odds depending on whether the cache broke (see the group note); repair and abort are alternative answers to the alert.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

神秘飞升不能用于荒野帝国；排外帝国在货舱轨道期间有额外修正；5067 的结果取决于是否“神秘不走运”，聪明/学习快的物种不会触发。

Enigmatic Ascension is unavailable to wilderness empires; xenophobe empires get an extra modifier while the cache is in orbit; 5067's outcome depends on being 'enigmatically unlucky', which intelligent or quick-learning species avoid.
